## About
The Heart and Dagger Saloon is Oakland's Grand Lake neighborhood rock and roll bar on Lake Park Ave. We pour a diverse selection of beer and liquor at low prices, and our bartenders are friendly pros.
Head out back and you'll find plenty of room on the patio, shade from our lemon tree and heaters for the colder nights. Inside there's a pool table, pinball machines and classic arcade video games. We have WiFi throughout, too.
All are welcome here. Even dogs, as long as they're bar-friendly. We're run by proprietors Allison Fontes and Erik Sadauskas, and we're open every day of the year, holidays included.

## Services
- Beer and liquor: A diverse selection at low prices, poured by our friendly staff of professional bartenders.
- Pool, pinball and arcade games: Shoot some pool, play pinball or try the classic arcade video games.
- Outdoor patio: Plenty of room out back under the lemon tree, with heaters for the colder days and nights.
- Sandwich Popup: A sandwich popup runs Thursday through Sunday.
- Merchandise: Heart and Dagger merch is on our Etsy shop, and we'll ship it straight to you.

## FAQ
Q: Can I bring my dog?
A: Yes. Dogs need to be leashed and by your side at all times. Dogs that have accidents, show aggression or cause problems will be asked to leave.

Q: Do you take cards?
A: We take cash, cards and tap-to-pay. Cash is preferred, and there's an ATM on site.

Q: Do I need I.D.?
A: Yes. We're 21 and over with valid I.D. No I.D., no service, no exceptions.

Q: Where do I park?
A: There's free car parking directly across the street, and on-site parking for bicycles and motorcycles.

Q: Are you open on holidays?
A: Yep. We're open all holidays.
